qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Extensive STM32 microcontroller developer ecosystem and long automotive qualification cycles create design-in switching costs, but heavy internal fab capital intensity and cyclical ASP erosion prevent sustained >12% ROIC across the cycle.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC & Pricing Power, REJECT). Capital-intensive integrated device manufacturer (IDM) exposed to severe automotive and industrial chip downcycles, aggressive Chinese silicon carbide (SiC) capacity expansion, and customer concentration (Apple, Tesla), keeping multi-cycle ROIC below the 12% hurdle.
qualitative.evidence: Multi-cycle ROIC falls to low single digits (~3-5%) during downcycles, failing the 12% cycle-average hurdle. Massive annual fab capex ($2.5B-$4B) creates high operating leverage, and the lack of secular pricing power against Tier-1 automotive and consumer OEMs leads to periodic margin compression.
